title: Selected physical AC1018 SAT-v1 source to same-version DXF projection
scope: Project one bounded physical AC1018 3DSOLID SAT-v1 carrier through same-version ASCII and Binary DXF, then prove exact decoded SAT text and selected entity metadata on fresh import.

source.producer_provenance: unverified; the publisher advertises a 3D pulley DWG sample

selected_record.projection_scope: Selected solid only, with source symbol tables and block-record metadata; unrelated entities, layouts, and graph members are excluded.

implementation.behavior: The selector imports the physical DWG, isolates source handle 0x27, writes same-version AC1018 ASCII and Binary DXF, freshly imports each output, reverses the SAT-v1 text transform, and compares the normalized payload byte-for-byte. It also checks unique 3DSOLID readback, consistent nonzero output identity, layer preservation, EED field shape, and ownership-safe block projection construction.

validation.focused_result: PASS; source handle 0x27 maps to output handle 0x40; ASCII and Binary fresh-import SAT payloads both exactly match the normalized 14,581-byte source payload
validation.asan_result: PASS; address sanitizer reported no errors. LeakSanitizer is unsupported by this platform's runtime, so detect_leaks was not enabled.

nonclaims: The source producer is not independently authenticated.
This source contains no EED fields on the selected solid, so it provides no EED APPID or layer-reference dependency evidence.
The projection is selected-record transport evidence; it does not prove SAT topology, geometry semantics, native CAD acceptance, producer breadth, or whole-document closure.
The other six SAT-v1 records and the remaining 18 opaque records in the source are not included in this projection.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added to the repository.
